name: Smart Post Block – Post Grid Gutenberg Blocks
author: WPBlock Lab

sections.description:
Enhance your WordPress website with Gutenberg Post Layouts, a powerful plugin designed to create stunning post layouts effortlessly. Whether you’re a blogger, marketer, or developer, this plugin helps you display your posts in beautiful grid layouts, grid templates, list templates, and taxonomy-based designs—without any coding!

Coupon Code

This plugins is still in development mode. So, I request not to purchase the plugins right now. Instead I am offering 100% coupon to test paid features.
Coupon: SMART100 (Only Available with Starter Single Package)

🚀 Key Features:
✅ Post Grid & List Layouts – Showcase your posts in a fully customizable grid or list format for a modern and clean look.
✅ Pre-Designed Templates – Choose from professionally designed grid templates and list layouts to match your site’s aesthetics.
✅ Taxonomy-Based Filters – Display posts dynamically based on categories, tags, or custom taxonomies, ensuring better content organization.
✅ Fully Responsive – Your layouts will look perfect on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
✅ Lightweight & Fast – Built with performance in mind, ensuring no impact on your site’s speed.
✅ Easy Customization – Adjust spacing, columns, colors, and typography directly from the WordPress block editor.

Similar Plugins

✅ Post Grid Gutenberg Blocks and WordPress Blog Plugin – PostX
✅ Advanced Post Block- Great solution for displaying Posts
✅ Spectra – WordPress Gutenberg Blocks
✅ The Post Grid – Shortcode, Gutenberg Blocks and Elementor Addon for Post Grid
✅ Ultimate Blocks – WordPress Blocks Plugin
✅ WordPress Popular Posts – Essential Blocks – Page Builder Gutenberg Blocks, Patterns & Templates

🎯 Why Choose Smart Post Block?
Our plugin is SEO-friendly, ensuring that your content remains structured for search engines. Plus, it’s compatible with all WordPress themes and integrates seamlessly into the Gutenberg block editor.

✅ No Coding Required – Just add the block and customize!
✅ Perfect for Blogs, News Sites & Portfolios – Create visually appealing content sections in minutes.
✅ Boost Engagement – Keep visitors on your site longer with attractive post layouts.
✅ Display Posts Based on Category
✅ Display Posts Based on Tags
✅ Display Posts Based on Category and Tags

✅ Random Posts
✅ Oldest Posts

✅ Reorder Posts

Download Smart Post Block plugins today and take your post designs to the next level! 🚀

What this plugins does?

Is this a Gutenberg Blocks plugin?

Yes, but it is a Gutenberg Post Block plugin. It displays the dynamic post on your page.

Where can I request new features?

We are available on the WordPress support forum.

Where can I report bugs and contribute to the project?

Bugs can be reported on the WordPress support forum.

Is it working with older version of WordPress?

It is a Gutenberg plugin it works great with WordPress version 5.x.x or more. And WordPress older version with Gutenberg plugin.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wppost-block directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is this plugin has slider support?

Currently we are not adding slider.

Can I add responsive design?

Yes, you can add responsive design.
